verdict.rationale: There is evidence of a documented QuickBooks Online API ecosystem (Node/PHP SDKs, OAuth flow, and an MCP server claiming 'complete coverage' of the QBO API), suggesting some ledger/report data could be pulled programmatically, but nothing in the pack explicitly confirms endpoints for the General Ledger or Trial Balance reports, nor confirms open formats (JSON/XML) for these reports. Probes also show the official OpenAPI spec and llms.txt are unavailable (404s), undermining the 'documented in open formats' claim. missing for 10: explicit documentation of GeneralLedger/TrialBalance report endpoints, confirmation of JSON/XML/CSV export formats for these reports, and a working OpenAPI/machine-readable spec.
